meta.name: surge-recon
meta.description: Growth state reconnaissance — scan existing onboarding flows, acquisition channels, conversion funnels, and growth experiment logs to understand current growth state. Use when asked to "what's our growth state", "audit the funnel", "what growth experiments have we run", "acquisition channel inventory", or before designing new growth experiments.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扫描现有获客渠道和转化漏斗，了解当前增长状态
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速了解产品增长现状再决定下一步实验
copy.tagline_en: Scan onboarding flows and conversion funnels to understand growth state
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a fast snapshot of your product's growth state before planning experiments

howto.what: 装了这个技能后，Claude 会变成增长工程师，扫描项目的入门流程、获取渠道、转化漏斗和增长实验日志，并用 CLI 格式输出报告；若超出 40 行，则生成 HTML 报告。
howto.when: 当你询问“我们的增长状态如何”、“审计漏斗”等，或要求进行增长实验前的侦察时触发。

say.note: Claude 会扫描各个转化阶段并评估追踪情况。

say.text: 列出我们运行过的增长实验
say.note: Claude 会查找 A/B 测试、PLG 元素等。

howto.what_en: Claude acts as a growth engineer, scanning onboarding flows, acquisition channels, conversion funnels, and growth experiment logs, then outputs a CLI report (or HTML if too long).
howto.when_en: Triggers when asked "what's our growth state", "audit the funnel", "acquisition channel inventory", or before designing new growth experiments.

say_en.note: Claude scans each funnel stage and tracking status.
Claude looks for A/B tests, PLG elements, etc.
Claude analyzes onboarding steps and activation points.
